game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Bone Crypt Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt, a dusty bone crypt: the torchbearer must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt: a dusty bone crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Crypt, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round, slime blobs strike the exit ledge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from slime blobs in Bone Crypt: keep the belt_count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: belt_count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Bone Crypt.
